scripts.build:adaptive-worker: npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && npm run extract:adaptive-worker && tsc -p examples/adaptive-worker/tsconfig.json
scripts.extract:adaptive-worker: node packages/sdk-typescript/dist/extract-cli.js --project examples/adaptive-worker/tsconfig.json --app adaptive-worker-demo --environment dev --out examples/adaptive-worker/generated/definitions.json --repository github.com/hahahahahaiyiwen/flaggo --source-path examples/adaptive-worker/src
scripts.test:adaptive-worker: npm run build:adaptive-worker && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/adaptive-worker/smoke.mjs
scripts.test:tetris-integration: npm run build --workspace @flaggo/sdk && dotnet build Flaggo.slnx -c Debug --no-restore && node examples/tetris-integration/run.mjs
